label: CCS: the driver as a current waveform
section: CCS: the driver as a current waveform
subgoals: Store the output current as a sampled waveform per grid point
Integrate current over time and divide by capacitance for voltage
Use the current to drive RC loads without a lumped Ceff guess

label: LVF: a sigma for every table entry
section: LVF: a sigma for every table entry
subgoals: Read the sigma table on the same grid as the mean table
Compute late delay as mean plus n sigma
Combine independent sigmas along a path by root-sum-square

label: Asymmetric sigmas and what LVF assumes
section: Asymmetric sigmas and what LVF assumes
subgoals: Use the early sigma for early delays and the late sigma for late delays
Compute the early-to-late spread as n times the sum of the sigmas
Recognize that LVF models local, independent variation only
